Name: Zebrus Where is my Item
Author: Zebruu
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Search items by name as you type. Results update instantly, including the total quantity right in the list.
Filter by mod and current location. Filters are combinable and automatically narrow each other.
Open an item's detail view to see the total quantity, and a breakdown of every chest, the fridge, and every player's inventory (including other players in multiplayer) it's currently found in, sorted by quantity. Custom chest names are shown where you've set one. Colored chests are shown with their actual color.
Scans every chest in every location - not just the farm, but anywhere you've placed one (the beach, the mountain lake, mine levels, wherever). Junimo chests (which all share one inventory in vanilla) are shown once rather than duplicated at every Junimo chest location.
The item list is rebuilt fresh every time you search, since chest contents change constantly while playing - unlike a fish or NPC list, this is never allowed to go stale.
You'll receive a welcome letter from Pierre on your first day, mentioning the search hotkey.[/color]

[/*]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Multiplayer safe - searches every connected player's inventory, not just your own. Equipped gear (hat, boots, rings, held tool) and the shipping bin are intentionally not included, since those aren't really "misplaced" items.
